The '''''Sarisa''-class gunship''' was an interstellar-range [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] model used by the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Crime Syndicate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] organization known as the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] used ''Sarisa''-class gunships. [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] and several other [[Pyke guard/Legends|Pyke guards]] used three gunships for a trip to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]], to join [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].<ref name="Eminence" /> Three of these ships were used to transport members of the Shadow Collective to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="SOR">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>
